en.title: Neighbours in shock after the murder: 'She was really nice'
en.summary: A woman was found dead in a flat in Luleå in the early hours of Friday. According to witnesses TV4 Nyheterna has spoken to, the police operation at the scene was extensive. So far the police have been very tight-lipped about the incident. – They knocked on the door at around 11 pm last night.
